title: David Leitch Says Ocean’s 14 Has a Strong Script, but Scheduling Remains the Hurdle
excerpt:
David Leitch says George Clooney and Grant Heslov have developed a promising script.
Bringing the ensemble together remains the key obstacle to production.
body_md:
The next Ocean’s film remains an active ambition for its creative team, but director David Leitch has offered a useful distinction between enthusiasm for a project and a confirmed production schedule. Although a script is in place and the people involved are eager to move forward, coordinating the availability of a star-studded ensemble is proving difficult.

Speaking to People, Leitch praised the work of George Clooney and Clooney’s producing partner Grant Heslov on the screenplay. He described the material as strong and emphasized the motivation surrounding the project. His central qualification was practical: assembling everyone at the same time is a persistent challenge when so many prominent performers are involved.

The sequel had previously been expected to begin filming in 2026. Leitch entered early discussions to direct in January 2025, and Clooney said in October 2025 that Warner Bros. had approved the film’s budget. Those developments were encouraging, but neither financial backing nor a finished screenplay guarantees that cameras can roll on a particular date. Leitch did not provide a replacement production timetable in his latest remarks.

The modern Ocean’s series began with Steven Soderbergh’s 2001 remake, which cast Clooney as Danny Ocean, the organizer of a stylish and elaborate heist. The film’s appeal depended as much on the chemistry and banter among its ensemble as on the mechanics of the robbery itself. Clooney returned for Ocean’s Twelve in 2004 and Ocean’s Thirteen in 2007, making the prospect of another reunion especially dependent on bringing the right people together.

Leitch’s involvement would also represent a change behind the camera. If he directs Ocean’s 14, it would be the first installment in the main series not directed by Soderbergh. The broader franchise has already explored another approach through Gary Ross’s 2018 spinoff Ocean’s 8, in which Sandra Bullock played Debbie Ocean, Danny’s sister.

There is also a separate Ocean’s prequel in development. Bradley Cooper is attached to write and direct that project, with Ryan Gosling and Margot Robbie attached to portray Danny Ocean’s parents. It is a distinct undertaking and should not be confused with the proposed fourth entry in the main series.

For now, the meaningful update is that the filmmakers remain enthusiastic and consider the screenplay promising, not that a start date has been locked. No new theatrical release date was announced. The next significant milestone will be confirmation that the production has secured the schedules necessary to reunite its ensemble.
seo_title: Ocean’s 14 Update: David Leitch on Script and Scheduling
seo_description: David Leitch praises George Clooney and Grant Heslov’s Ocean’s 14 script while explaining why scheduling the ensemble remains difficult.
